html:
Rotate text right by k positions, where k is any integer. Negative k rotates left. Empty text remains empty.

Call solve with the positional arguments shown in each test. Return the result; do not print.

Example

{
  "args": [
    "planet",
    2
  ],
  "expected": "etplan"
}

Example

{
  "args": [
    "abcd",
    -1
  ],
  "expected": "bcda"
}
Hint

Reduce the shift modulo the length.

Complexity: O(n) time and output space

489 explicit tests pass across the 160 original exercises

solutions.name: rotate-text.py
solutions.code:
def solve(text, k):
    if not text: return text
    k %= len(text)
    return text[-k:] + text[:-k] if k else text
